name: GUNMETAL//VERMILLION
source:
Life is not what it used to be for Absinthe and Shion. Circumstances have forced them to bow down their heads but the spirit isn't crushed so easily.

[From [url=https://densendischarge.itch.io/gunmetal-vermillion]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对于苦艾酒和紫苑来说，生活已经不再是以前的样子了。环境迫使他们低下头，但他们的精神却没有那么容易被击垮。

[来自[url=https://densendischarge.itch.io/gunmetal-vermillion]itch.io[/url]]
